explanation: Zelda is the princess of the kingdom of Hyrule. Shigeru Miyamoto has said he named her after Zelda Fitzgerald, wife of the American novelist F. Scott Fitzgerald.

claims.text: In The Legend of Zelda games, the player controls a hero named Link.
In the series Zelda is a princess and Ganon the main villain, and Kirby is the hero of a different Nintendo series.
Zelda is the princess of the kingdom of Hyrule.
Shigeru Miyamoto has said Princess Zelda was named after Zelda Fitzgerald, the wife of F. Scott Fitzgerald.

evidence.restatement: Link is the player character in the main Zelda games, but not in all of them. Zelda is the playable hero of The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom (2024) and of a few earlier CD-i and spin-off titles, so 'the player controls a hero named Link' is not true of every game.

claimResults.note: The writer flagged this claim for doubt, and the doubt is justified. True as the series convention, not as a flat statement about all the games.
